WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       trade_count,
       1.0 * trade_count / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM type_counts;
